messages:
Ash: Heads-up: planning a brief unpin of runtime 2.16 -> 3.1 in NA-canary tomorrow 01:30 UTC, 60m window. Quick tests show perf win on long-seq for quant-v3.
Beck: OK but add a pin-exclusion for customer-special models; last time one customer hit a binding mismatch.
Ravi: Rollout steps? prefer 15% -> 60% -> 100% with automated gates.
Ash: Yep that's the plan. Gates: p95 latency delta >25% OR error rate +0.4% -> rollback. Memory OOM signs also immediate abort.
Beck: Deploybot, can you run a preflight and check pinlist for explicit model bindings?
deploybot: deploybot: preflight started by @Ash  check: image signatures OK, pinlist scan in progress.
ops-bot: ops-bot: pinlist scan result: found 1 explicit binding m-21aa for runtime:2.16. Suggested action: exclude m-21aa from cohort.
Ash: Exclude it. Also add a note in release notes: "NA canary unpin to runtime 3.1; SDKs older than 2.9 may see degraded perf."
Ravi: I'll handle the SDK blurb and ping CS. Beck: can you run the long-seq curl during 15% step?
Beck: Yep will run smoke checks and the p99 token generation test.
deploybot: deploybot: patched pinlist applied  excluded models: m-21aa. Dry-run ready. To apply live: `deploybot apply-unpin 6880000000 --live`
Ash: If no objections by EOD I'll apply dry-run and then flip live at the window.
Ravi: ack.
Beck: ack, will monitor dashboards.
